checks.source_hash_and_offset_check_python:
import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
d = json.loads((root / "examples/public-cases/policy/dataset.json").read_text())
s = json.loads((root / "examples/public-cases/policy/sources.json").read_text())
for src in d["manifest"]["sources"]:
    p = root / src["path"]
    assert p.is_file(), str(p)
    assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == src["sha256"], str(p)
    assert src["raw_url"].removeprefix("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/docs/").split("/")[0] == src["upstream_commit"], src["id"]
    assert next(x for x in s["sources"] if x["id"] == src["id"]) == src
for artifact in s["license_provenance"]:
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / artifact["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == artifact["sha256"], artifact["path"]
for evidence in d["evidence"]:
    locator = evidence["locator"]
    text = (root / locator["path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert text[locator["start"]:locator["end"]] == evidence["content"], evidence["id"]
    assert next(src for src in d["manifest"]["sources"] if src["id"] == evidence["source_id"])["path"] == locator["path"]
assert len(d["items"]) == 12
assert all(q["origin"] == "synthetic" and q["author"] == "case-policy-author" for q in d["items"])
assert all(q["verification"]["status"] == "pending" and not q["verification"]["independent"] and not q["verification"]["reviewer"] for q in d["items"])
assert d["manifest"]["status"] == "draft" and d["manifest"]["review"]["approved_by"] == "" and d["manifest"]["review"]["approved_at"] == ""
print(json.dumps({"source_hashes_checked": len(d["manifest"]["sources"]), "license_provenance_hashes_checked": len(s["license_provenance"]), "evidence_offsets_checked": len(d["evidence"]), "synthetic_pending_items_checked": len(d["items"]), "review": "pending; no approval or freeze", "result": "pass"}))
